commit_rule: This first generated key became immediately authoritative and is immutable. A repair may change serialization or code, but may not replace this key or condition on any resulting assignment.
probability_model: The 256-bit key was sampled once from the operating-system CSPRNG before any F1 candidate outcome existed. Conditional reproducibility uses HMAC-SHA256. Design-unbiasedness is claimed over the key-generation experiment under the standard keyed-PRF/random-oracle idealization; it is not claimed over a fixed deterministic identifier hash.
